user.title: Set up BonnVoyage
user.description: Parking occupancy, roadworks, live traffic and messages for Bonn – no account, no API key. First choose the area in which roadworks, traffic messages and congestion should appear.

data_description.area: Move the marker and adjust the circle. The default is your home with a 10 km radius – covering the city and the A555, A559 and A565 motorways.

parking.title: Select parking facilities
parking.description: Live occupancy of Bonn's parking facilities. The list is sorted by distance from your home; facilities within 3 km are preselected – just adjust the selection. You can add or remove facilities at any time later.

data_description.parkings: Each selected facility gets sensors for free spaces, occupancy, trend and open state – including its position for the map.

parking_unavailable.title: Parking data unavailable
parking_unavailable.description: The parking feed (BCP Bonn) is currently unreachable. You can retry or continue without parking facilities – they can be added at any time later.

routes_menu.title: Routes with travel times?
routes_menu.description: For live travel times and congestion alerts on your own routes (e.g. home → office) BonnVoyage uses an external routing service. This requires the provider's API key – the free tier covers about 2 routes polled around the clock (20,000 requests/month). Parking, city traffic and messages work without any key.

menu_options.provider: Set up a travel time provider now (API key required)
menu_options.finish: Finish without routes – can be added any time

provider.title: Travel time provider
provider.description: Choose a provider and enter your API key. You get a free key from the provider's developer portal. Privacy note: the coordinates of your configured routes are sent to the provider (rounded to ~11 m); nothing else leaves your home. The key is stored locally in Home Assistant.

data_description.api_key: Validated with a test request when you continue.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew API key
reauth_confirm.description: The travel time provider no longer accepts the stored API key for {name}. Enter a valid key to bring the route sensors back. Parking, city traffic and messages are not affected.

error.invalid_auth: The provider rejected the API key. Check that the key was copied completely and is enabled for the routing API.
error.cannot_connect: The travel time provider is currently unreachable. This is not a problem with your key – check your internet connection and try again in a few minutes.
error.rate_limited: The provider reports too many requests (quota reached). Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.single_instance_allowed: BonnVoyage is already set up. Add routes and parking facilities via the existing integration.
abort.reauth_successful: The API key was updated successfully.

user.title: Add parking facility
user.description: The list is sorted by distance from your home. Facilities that are already configured are not shown.

abort.bcp_unavailable: The parking feed (BCP Bonn) is currently unreachable. Please try again later.
abort.all_configured: All currently reported parking facilities are already configured.
abort.no_parkings: No parking facilities are currently being reported. This is usually a temporary problem of the BCP feed – please try again later.

provider.title: Set up travel time provider
provider.description: Routes need an external routing service – this step is only required once. Your parking facilities, city traffic and messages keep working independently. You get a free API key from the provider's developer portal; route coordinates are sent to the provider (rounded).

data_description.api_key: Validated with a test request when you continue.

start.title: Add route – start (1/3)
start.description: Where does the route begin? Choose one of your zones or pick a point on the map in the next step.

data_description.start: Zones are the locations stored in Home Assistant, e.g. Home or Work.

start_map.title: Pick the start on the map (1/3)
start_map.description: Move the marker to the starting point. It should be on or near a drivable road.

dest.title: Add route – destination (2/3)
dest.description: Where does the route go? Choose a zone or pick a point on the map in the next step.

dest_map.title: Pick the destination on the map (2/3)
dest_map.description: Move the marker to the destination. It should be on or near a drivable road.

settings.title: Finish route (3/3)
settings.description: Almost done: check the name and set the congestion threshold. A probe route is calculated when you save.

data_description.name: Used for the sensor names, e.g. "Home → Office".
data_description.delay_threshold: The congestion sensor reports a problem once the delay compared to free flow reaches this value (minutes).
data_description.add_via: Forces the route via an intermediate point, e.g. the A565. Not needed for most routes.

via_map.title: Pick the via point on the map
via_map.description: Move the marker to the point the route should pass through.

error.invalid_auth: The provider rejected the API key. Check that the key was copied completely and is enabled for the routing API.
error.cannot_connect: The travel time provider is currently unreachable. Check your internet connection and try again in a few minutes.
error.rate_limited: The provider reports too many requests (quota reached). Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.route_not_found: No route could be calculated for the chosen points. Check that start and destination are on or near a drivable road and move the marker if needed.
error.points_too_close: Start and destination are too close together. Choose two different places at least a few hundred meters apart.
error.name_exists: A route with this name already exists. Choose a different name.

user.title: Watch city route – show location (1/3)
user.description: The city of Bonn measures live traffic on 111 main road segments. Put the marker on the street you care about – the next step shows the measured segments nearby and you pick one explicitly. Tip: the city's own traffic map at https://stadtplan.bonn.de shows which streets are measured. To display street names, only the coordinates of the city's measurement segments are sent to an OpenStreetMap service – never your picked point.

data_description.location: Rough aiming is fine: every measured segment within 2 km is offered for selection.

select.title: Pick a segment (2/3)
select.description: These measured segments are close to your point, sorted by distance. Direction = driving direction of the segment (compass).{geocoder_note}

name.title: Set a name (3/3)
name.description: Selected: {segment_label}. The device and its sensors (traffic status, speed, congestion) appear under this name.

data_description.name: Adjust the suggestion if you like, e.g. "Adenauerallee inbound".

error.no_segment_nearby: No measured segment within 2 km of the chosen point. The city only measures selected main roads – the city traffic map (link above) shows which.
error.already_configured: This segment is already being watched. Pick another one or reposition the point.
error.name_exists: A city route with this name already exists. Choose a different name.

abort.segments_unavailable: The city traffic layer is currently unreachable. Please try again later.

user.title: Watch transit stop
user.description: Live departures for Bonn's trams and buses via the community service transitous.org (DELFI data) – no API key needed. Search for a stop by name.

data_description.delay_alert_threshold: The delay sensor reports a problem once an upcoming departure is delayed by this many minutes.

select.title: Pick a stop
select.description: Matches sorted by distance from your home.

error.no_stops_found: No stops found for this search. Try the official stop name, e.g. "Bonn Hauptbahnhof".
error.already_configured: This stop is already being watched.

abort.transitous_unavailable: transitous.org is currently unreachable. Please try again later.

init.title: BonnVoyage options
init.description: Adjust the area for roadworks, traffic messages and congestion. Routes, city routes and parking facilities are managed directly on the integration page.

data_description.area: Center and radius in which roadworks, traffic warnings and congestion appear.

source_down.title: Data source unavailable for hours
source_down.description: The data source `{source}` has been failing for more than 6 hours. The affected entities are unavailable. Check your internet connection; if it is fine, the upstream service is disrupted — this issue disappears automatically once the source recovers.
